scope: Arizona custom/luxury-home builders and design-build firms screened from public official-company pages. A record is included only where an official page shows a live available/under-construction offering, an active community, a current inquiry/vendor path, or an active custom-home/design-build service. Emails are included only where visibly published on the company's official domain.

qualifiedCompanies.currentProjectNeedSignal: The live portfolio lists Scottsdale custom-home work and the Ritz-Carlton Residences luxury residential development (80 villas / 300,000+ sq. ft.). Its live contact page actively solicits custom-home, remodel, and design-forward residential project conversations and has a vendor-intake path.
qualifiedCompanies.likelyApexGridServiceFit: Civil/site and drainage coordination for luxury estates and residential developments; structural and MEP engineering coordination; permit-ready drafting and revision support.
